description: Erection of a single-storey rear extension, first floor rear extension and a two-storey side extension, front porch and conversion of roof from hip roof to gable.
decision_conditions: The proposed single-storey rear extension, first floor rear extension, two-storey side extension and conversion of roof from hip roof to gable would result in an incongruous form of development that would be detrimental to the visual amenities of the streetscene and the character and appearance of the surrounding area and would result in a moderate level of less than substantial harm to the West Drayton Green Conservation Area that would fail to be outweighed by the public benefits of the development. The development would be contrary to Policies BE1 and HE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (2012); Policies DMHB 1, DMHB 4, DMHB 11, DMHB 12, DMHB 14 and DMHD1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020), Policies Policy HC1, D1 and D3 of the London Plan (2021) , Policy HE6 of the NPPF(2026) and Section 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended).
